newsitem.title: USA: US corporate bonds up slightly in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: US corporate bonds up slightly in quiet trade.

text.p: U.S. high-grade corporate bonds were slightly higher Tuesday afternoon, tracking U.S. Treasuries in very quiet post holiday dealings.
"There's no significant change in spreads...they've tightened a touch but the market's still very quiet," one high-grade trader said.
Trading should remain light as market players continue to trickle in from the long holiday weekend and ahead of the upcoming U.S. jobs report, dealers added.
"The employment numbers are going to dominate everything in the foreseeable future," said another high-grade trader.
